items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: I had Muggsy Spanier and Mes Mesro and Baby Dodds and Pops Foster and George Wettling. In other words, I had enough to make up about eight bands.

ctx.x: I had Muggsy Spanier and Mes Mesro and Baby Dodds and Pops Foster and George Wettling. In other words, I had enough to make up about eight bands. Yeah. And I had Muggsy Spanier and Mes Mesro and Baby Dodds and Pops Foster and George Wettling. In other words, I had enough to make up about eight bands. Yeah. Including Louie. And it was a very successful affair. Oh. They had a, somebody did a bust of Louie over there and it stands in the public square in Lees, a bronze bust. And it was very nice. He was delighted…

Getting back to Louie, there's, did you, I don't know if you told me this, when Louie came down, once he, he has Face on Time Magazine. Yeah. And, I don't know where this rumor came from, I heard, that he tried to hit a room at the Roosevelt Hotel at that time?
